description: This file is a C header file containing declarations and macros for secure system call wrappers, including functions like v_secure_system, v_secure_popen, and related macros and constants, used for secure command execution and process handling in tests or stubs.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Wrapper around system() that enforces compile-time checks for format string correctness.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Wrapper around popen() with compile-time checks for direction and format string.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Closes a FILE pointer opened by v_secure_popen.

methods.name: contains_secure_separator
methods.description: Obsolete inline function that always returns 0.
